3. **Set your working resolution.** Use **Res** above the timeline. The refine result uses this size; the upscale result doubles its width and height. For example, **896 × 512 → 1792 × 1024**.
4. **Describe the refinement.** If running a refine pass, double-click empty **[Prompt](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#prompt-sections)** space near the bottom of the timeline, describe the look you want, then click **Create**. Scroll down inside the timeline if Prompt is out of view.
5. **Choose the part to process.** Set **[In / Out](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#ways-to-set-in-and-out)** above the timeline and press **Enter** after each value. Start with a short section inside your footage.
6. **Make your first version.** Open **[Render Queue](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#the-render-queue)** at the bottom of the Assets sidebar and turn **Queue Active** off. In ComfyUI, click **✕ Exit** at the upper right, then **Run**. **Install the required nodes.** Install [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), [ComfyUI-LTXVideo](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo), and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF) through **Extensions → ComfyUI Manager** at the top right of ComfyUI. Search **Sonder Editor**, **KJNodes**, **ComfyUI-LTXVideo**, and **RES4LYF**. Restart ComfyUI and refresh your browser afterward.

**Prepare the editor.** Above the timeline, use **Model: LTX 2.3 / 2.5** and **Channels: Standard**.

**Use frame numbers for these examples.** If the toolbar shows **Duration**, click **TC** above the timeline so it shows **Frames** instead. The In / Out and context values below are frame counts.

**Start with the supplied settings.** For your first test, set **Ctx: Pre/Post 0** and **Mask −/+ 0** above the timeline. Keep the selected range inside your footage.

- [ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-lora-450-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/loras/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-lora-450-bf16.safetensors)

A mask is a black-and-white video that follows your footage: **white character, black background**. Match its timing and framing to the source. For example, use the result of **Make a Subject Mask** in the **LTX 2.5 Edit & VFX** workflow.

1. **Add your mask.** Import it through **Assets**, then drag it onto a **Video** lane. Right-click its clip and choose **[Convert to Driver](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#driver-clips)**. Keep your original footage on Video.
2. **Choose that Driver.** In **Controls → Generation → Mask video lane**, select the lane containing your mask.
3. **Choose the area to refine.** Under **Modes → Refine Pass Spatial Mask**, select **Refine Character** or **Refine Environment**.

The mask focuses refinement; it does not guarantee that everything outside the chosen area stays unchanged.

**Check the processed mask.** The preview turns on automatically with **Refine Character** or **Refine Environment**, and off with **Mask Off**. At the top of a viewport pane, open its source menu and choose **Mask Preview**. Click that pane’s **Run** to check the mask without running diffusion.

Masking changes the refine pass only. ","group":"","order":13},"refine_review":{"text":"**Review your results**

- **Find your results.** Open **Assets** at the upper left. With both passes, the refine result stays in Assets and only the upscaled result is added to the timeline. With one pass, that result is added.
- **Compare versions.** Double-click a result in Assets, then click **[Compare](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#compare-mode)**.
- **Use the finished video.** Saved videos include the timeline’s sound for the processed section. Your existing Audio lanes stay unchanged; no duplicate Audio lanes are added.
- **Change where results go.** The **Passes** choices set the save destinations automatically. After choosing a Mode, open **Controls → Editor** and use **Refine save as** and **Upscale save as**: **Take** adds the result to the timeline; **Video** saves it in Assets without placing it.
- **Choose the file quality.** In **Controls → Editor**, set **Refine output format** or **Upscale output format** to **Lossless FFV1 (RGB)** or **Editing Master MP4** when the result will go through more editing or another workflow. Use **High Quality MP4** for the finished video. Lossless files can be much larger.
- **Before running again.** Keep the footage you want to process visible on Video and mute competing takes.

**Tip — choose what the next take builds on.** In **Controls → Editor**, turn **Takes start muted** **on** to keep trying from the original clip, or **off** to build on each new result. 4. **Describe the refinement.** If running a refine pass, double-click empty **[Prompt](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#prompt-sections)** space near the bottom of the timeline, describe the look you want, then click **Create**. Scroll down inside the timeline if Prompt is out of view.
5. **Choose the part to process.** Set **[In / Out](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#ways-to-set-in-and-out)** above the timeline and press **Enter** after each value. Start with a short section inside your footage.
6. **Make your first version.** Open **[Render Queue](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#the-render-queue)** at the bottom of the Assets sidebar and turn **Queue Active** off. In ComfyUI, click **✕ Exit** at the upper right, then **Run**. In Sonder App, click **[Generate](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/sonder-app.md#generate)** with **×1** selected.","group":"","order":10},"refine_requirements":{"text":"**Requirements and setup**

**Install the required nodes.** Install [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), [ComfyUI-LTXVideo](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo), and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF) through **Extensions → ComfyUI Manager** at the top right of ComfyUI. Search **Sonder Editor**, **KJNodes**, **ComfyUI-LTXVideo**, and **RES4LYF**. Restart ComfyUI and refresh your browser afterward.

**Prepare the editor.** Above the timeline, use **Model: LTX 2.3 / 2.5** and **Channels: Standard**.

**Use frame numbers for these examples.** If the toolbar shows **Duration**, click **TC** above the timeline so it shows **Frames** instead. The In / Out and context values below are frame counts.

**Start with the supplied settings.** For your first test, set **Ctx: Pre/Post 0** and **Mask −/+ 0** above the timeline. Keep the selected range inside your footage.

**Load your models.** Expand **Models and downloads** below. If **advanced hidden** appears under Modes, click it. Expand **Models and LoRAs** to select your installed files.","group":"","order":11},"refine_models":{"text":"**Models and downloads**

Click a filename to open its download page. Put it in the folder shown inside **ComfyUI/models/**.

**Main models**

- [ltx-2.5-22b-dev-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-dev-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) → **diffusion_models/**
- [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) → **text_encoders/**
- [ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors) → **vae/LTX/**
- [ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors) → **vae/LTX/**
- [ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/latent_upscale_models/ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors) → **latent_upscale_models/**

**LoRAs — put these in loras/LTX/**

- [ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-lora-450-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/loras/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-lora-450-bf16.safetensors)
- [ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-refine-details-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Refine-Details/blob/main/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-refine-details-1.0.safetensors)
- [ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-decompression-0.9.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Decompression/blob/main/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-decompression-0.9.safetensors)

**For the live sampling preview**

- [taeltx2_3.safetensors](https://github.com/madebyollin/taehv/blob/main/safetensors/taeltx2_3.safetensors) → **vae_approx/**

Some Lightricks downloads require signing in to Hugging Face and accepting model access first.

**Use models from other folders.** If **advanced hidden** appears below Modes, click it. Expand **Models and LoRAs**, then select your installed files in the matching controls.","group":"","order":12},"refine_use_mask":{"text":"**Use a mask**

A mask is a black-and-white video that follows your footage: **white character, black background**. Match its timing and framing to the source. For example, use the result of **Make a Subject Mask** in the **LTX 2.5 Edit & VFX** workflow.

1. **Add your mask.** Import it through **Assets**, then drag it onto a **Video** lane. Right-click its clip and choose **[Convert to Driver](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#driver-clips)**. Keep your original footage on Video.
2. **Choose that Driver.** In **Controls → Generation → Mask video lane**, select the lane containing your mask.
3. **Choose the area to refine.** Under **Modes → Refine Pass Spatial Mask**, select **Refine Character** or **Refine Environment**.

The mask focuses refinement; it does not guarantee that everything outside the chosen area stays unchanged.

**Check the processed mask.** The preview turns on automatically with **Refine Character** or **Refine Environment**, and off with **Mask Off**. At the top of a viewport pane, open its source menu and choose **Mask Preview**. Click that pane’s **Run** to check the mask without running diffusion.

Masking changes the refine pass only. ","group":"","order":13},"refine_review":{"text":"**Review your results**

- **Find your results.** Open **Assets** at the upper left. With both passes, the refine result stays in Assets and only the upscaled result is added to the timeline. With one pass, that result is added.
- **Compare versions.** Double-click a result in Assets, then click **[Compare](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#compare-mode)**.
- **Use the finished video.** Saved videos include the timeline’s sound for the processed section. Your existing Audio lanes stay unchanged; no duplicate Audio lanes are added.
- **Change where results go.** The **Passes** choices set the save destinations automatically. After choosing a Mode, open **Controls → Editor** and use **Refine save as** and **Upscale save as**: **Take** adds the result to the timeline; **Video** saves it in Assets without placing it.
- **Choose the file quality.** In **Controls → Editor**, set **Refine output format** or **Upscale output format** to **Lossless FFV1 (RGB)** or **Editing Master MP4** when the result will go through more editing or another workflow. Use **High Quality MP4** for the finished video. Lossless files can be much larger.
- **Before running again.** Keep the footage you want to process visible on Video and mute competing takes.

**Tip — choose what the next take builds on.** In **Controls → Editor**, turn **Takes start muted** **on** to keep trying from the original clip, or **off** to build on each new result. ## LTX 2.5 Refine & Upscale

Improve the detail of your footage or make a larger version.

[Watch the showcase video](https://youtu.be/y5QkousNNWo)

1. On the **Sonder Editor** node below, choose a project or **+ Create New**, then click **Open Editor**.
2. Open **Controls** at the upper left. Under **Modes → Passes**, choose what you want to run.
3. Expand **Start here** for the steps, or **Requirements and setup** for installation.

**Custom nodes:** [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), [ComfyUI-LTXVideo](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo), and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF). Install them through **Extensions → ComfyUI Manager** at the top right, then restart ComfyUI and refresh this page.
